title: Tandem Skydive Checklist
description: Recall flashcards from user-supplied course-material images; not official exam questions.
sourcePolicy: Source_verified means faithful to the supplied image, not independent verification against every current manual. Older procedures and unattributed checklist values must not silently override newer manufacturer guidance.

usage.grading: Self-assess recall cards; do not require correctOptionId. Use includeInQuiz for default scored practice; review excluded cards separately.
usage.practice: Rehearse EP handle sequences with the examiner in a training harness. Canopy drills are supervised course exercises.

sources.title: Tandem Skydive Checklist
sources.revision: Publisher, revision and date not visible

cards.question: What are the initial preparation tasks?
cards.answer: Retrieve rig/student harness and move to tandem area; preflight rig; meet student; introduce yourself, ask experience and medical issues, build rapport, offer restroom opportunity.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What are the harness-fitting and initial briefing tasks?
cards.answer: Select jumpsuit if applicable; fit/tighten harness as prescribed; explain actions and where hands will touch; review exit, skydive basics and deployment once harnessed; keep student near gear-up area.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What does the checklist say about donning the rig and moving to boarding?
cards.answer: Don and adjust rig. If rig left your sight since preflight, additional soft gear check. Move together at 5-minute call while maintaining positive student control.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What checks precede boarding?
cards.answer: Confirm boarding/exit order; maintain positive control in boarding area; check own gear and student harness just before boarding.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What are the aircraft-entry tasks?
cards.answer: Maintain student control; stand between student and propeller if possible; remind student to watch head; direct seating; secure both seat belts and explain operation.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: When does this checklist remove seat belts?
cards.answer: At 1,500 feet; check both belts completely clear of legs. This is an unverified course-checklist value.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What tasks follow seat-belt removal?
cards.answer: Hook both lower attachment points to instructor lower attachment rings; slightly tighten lower straps; complete system check including drogue; signal thumbs-up to door skydiver once complete.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: At what altitude does this checklist complete hookup?
cards.answer: 8,000 feet. Vocalize actions and that each attachment is secure. This is an unverified course-checklist value.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What is the complete-hookup check sequence listed?
cards.answer: Own chest/leg strap continuity and fit; tighten student back strap; tighten lowers; clip uppers; tighten uppers; check student leg buckles, loosen belly band, check chest strap; another complete systems check.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What door and exit tasks are listed?
cards.answer: Slide toward door while checking drogue security; set up, check drogue again, begin count; hard arch with limbs in wide X; check airspace, set drogue, check drogue; complete system check.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What orientation and deployment tasks are listed?
cards.answer: Face sun if possible; turn perpendicular to jump run before deployment if possible; at 6,000 feet wave and pull drogue release. The altitude is this checklist's planned value.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What checks come immediately after deployment?
cards.answer: Assess initial canopy; controllability check with both toggle sets; continuity check from canopy to student; turn appropriate direction; give student yellow toggles if applicable.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What comfort-adjustment sequence is listed?
cards.answer: Explain making student comfortable; use quick ejectors to remove lower straps, lengthen and promptly reattach; slightly loosen chest strap if necessary; ask student to bring knees to chest and slide back in harness.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What practice and control-transfer tasks are listed?
cards.answer: Two practice landings emphasizing student feet up; retrieve black toggles by 1,500 feet.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What high-wind RSL altitude does this checklist list?
cards.answer: Below 1,000 feet. This differs from the 2026 EP study guide allowing disconnection below 1,500 feet including on ground; retain source distinction and confirm examiner expectations.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What pattern-entry altitude does this checklist list?
cards.answer: 600–700 feet, at the appropriate altitude. Treat as a course-specific value requiring verification against the jump plan and other source guidance.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What final-approach and landing actions are listed?
cards.answer: Repeat legs/feet up instruction; place instructor legs/feet under student's; flare when appropriate; assume slide landing; if winds permit ask student to stand at last moment; if catchers present ask student to open hands.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What student-care tasks follow landing?
cards.answer: Disconnect student from rig; unbuckle belly/chest straps and loosen legs; keep harness on until gear-up area; instructor or videographer stays with student until clear of landing area.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.

cards.question: What closes the jump workflow?
cards.answer: Stow toggles and gather canopy/gear; deliver gear to packing; meet student in tandem area to remove harness and debrief.
cards.explanation: Answer transcribed or paraphrased from the named course material.
cards.reviewNote: Course checklist has no visible revision; verify against applicable manuals and examiner briefing.
